title.en: IELTS Reading: Matching information: which paragraph says it?
title.uz: IELTS Reading: Matching information — bu qaysi xatboshida aytilgan?
title.ru: IELTS Reading: Matching information — в каком абзаце это сказано?

body.en:
In Matching information, each question names one piece of information, and you find the paragraph that contains it. The information is often small: a reason, an example, a number, a comparison or a problem.
This is not Matching headings. A heading sums up a whole paragraph; here the answer can be one sentence in the middle of a paragraph.
1. Read the question and mark the kind of information it asks for: "a reason", "an example", "a number".
2. Think how the text could say it in other words.
3. Scan the paragraphs for those words, then read the whole sentence.
Check the instructions: some tasks let you use a letter more than once.
body.uz:
Matching information (maʼlumotni moslashtirish) topshirigʻida har bir savolda bitta maʼlumot koʻrsatiladi, siz esa u qaysi xatboshida ekanini topasiz. Bu maʼlumot koʻpincha kichik boʻladi: sabab, misol, son, taqqoslash yoki muammo.
Bu Matching headings emas. Sarlavha butun xatboshining mazmunini aytadi; bu yerda esa javob xatboshi oʻrtasidagi bitta gap boʻlishi mumkin.
1. Savolni oʻqing va u qanday maʼlumot soʻrayotganini belgilang: «sabab», «misol», «son».
2. Matn buni boshqa soʻzlar bilan qanday aytishi mumkinligini oʻylang.
3. Xatboshilardan shu soʻzlarni qidiring, keyin butun gapni oʻqing.
Koʻrsatmani tekshiring: baʼzi topshiriqlarda bitta harfni bir necha marta ishlatish mumkin.
body.ru:
В задании Matching information (сопоставление информации) каждый вопрос называет одну деталь, а вы находите абзац, где она есть. Деталь часто мелкая: причина, пример, число, сравнение или проблема.
Это не Matching headings. Заголовок передаёт смысл всего абзаца, а здесь ответом может быть одно предложение в середине абзаца.
1. Прочитайте вопрос и отметьте, какую информацию он ищет: «причину», «пример», «число».
2. Подумайте, какими другими словами это может сказать текст.
3. Ищите эти слова в абзацах, затем прочитайте всё предложение.
Проверьте инструкцию: в некоторых заданиях одну букву можно использовать несколько раз.

body.en:
Text:
A  Hollin Farm grows apples and pears on a hill above the village of Cray.
B  In 2019 a late frost killed most of the blossom, and the farm lost half its apples.
C  Since then the farm has planted hedges, which shelter the trees from cold wind.
D  On Saturdays in September, visitors can pick their own fruit and buy juice at the gate.
Question: Which paragraph describes a way of protecting the trees?
1. Kind of information: a way to protect.
2. Other words: shelter, keep safe.
3. C: hedges "shelter the trees from cold wind". Answer: C. Not B: it names the problem, not the protection.
Now you. Question: Which paragraph mentions an event that made a harvest smaller?
1. Kind of information: an event; a smaller harvest.
2. Other words: lost, killed, fewer.
3. Scan the paragraphs for these words.
4. Answer: Paragraph ?
body.uz:
Matn:
A  Hollin Farm grows apples and pears on a hill above the village of Cray.
B  In 2019 a late frost killed most of the blossom, and the farm lost half its apples.
C  Since then the farm has planted hedges, which shelter the trees from cold wind.
D  On Saturdays in September, visitors can pick their own fruit and buy juice at the gate.
Savol: Which paragraph describes a way of protecting the trees?
1. Maʼlumot turi: himoya qilish usuli.
2. Boshqa soʻzlar: shelter, keep safe.
3. C: hedges «shelter the trees from cold wind». Javob: C. B emas: unda himoya emas, muammo aytilgan.
Endi siz. Savol: Which paragraph mentions an event that made a harvest smaller?
1. Maʼlumot turi: hodisa; hosil kamaygan.
2. Boshqa soʻzlar: lost, killed, fewer.
3. Xatboshilardan shu soʻzlarni qidiring.
4. Javob: Paragraph ?
body.ru:
Текст:
A  Hollin Farm grows apples and pears on a hill above the village of Cray.
B  In 2019 a late frost killed most of the blossom, and the farm lost half its apples.
C  Since then the farm has planted hedges, which shelter the trees from cold wind.
D  On Saturdays in September, visitors can pick their own fruit and buy juice at the gate.
Вопрос: Which paragraph describes a way of protecting the trees?
1. Вид информации: способ защиты.
2. Другие слова: shelter, keep safe.
3. C: hedges «shelter the trees from cold wind». Ответ: C. Не B: там проблема, а не защита.
Теперь попробуйте сами. Вопрос: Which paragraph mentions an event that made a harvest smaller?
1. Вид информации: событие; урожай стал меньше.
2. Другие слова: lost, killed, fewer.
3. Ищите эти слова в абзацах.
4. Ответ: абзац ?

body.en:
Watch out: the same word is not the same information.
The paragraph that repeats a word from the question is often the wrong one. The right paragraph usually says the idea in other words.
Question: Which paragraph gives a reason for a delay?
A  "The new bridge was planned for 2020, but the work was delayed." It repeats "delayed", but gives no reason.
B  "Heavy rain flooded the river for two months, and the builders had to stop." This is the reason. ✔
So look for the information, not the word, and read the whole sentence before you choose.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: bir xil soʻz — bir xil maʼlumot degani emas.
Savoldagi soʻzni takrorlaydigan xatboshi koʻpincha notoʻgʻri boʻladi. Toʻgʻri xatboshi odatda fikrni boshqa soʻzlar bilan aytadi.
Savol: Which paragraph gives a reason for a delay?
A  «The new bridge was planned for 2020, but the work was delayed.» Unda «delayed» soʻzi bor, lekin sabab yoʻq.
B  «Heavy rain flooded the river for two months, and the builders had to stop.» Mana sabab. ✔
Demak, soʻzni emas, maʼlumotni qidiring va tanlashdan oldin butun gapni oʻqing.
body.ru:
Осторожно: одно и то же слово — ещё не та же информация.
Абзац, который повторяет слово из вопроса, часто оказывается неверным. Верный абзац обычно передаёт мысль другими словами.
Вопрос: Which paragraph gives a reason for a delay?
A  «The new bridge was planned for 2020, but the work was delayed.» Здесь есть «delayed», но причины нет.
B  «Heavy rain flooded the river for two months, and the builders had to stop.» Вот причина. ✔
Итак, ищите информацию, а не слово, и читайте всё предложение, прежде чем выбрать.

title.en: IELTS Reading: Completing a flow chart

body.en:
A flow chart shows the steps of a process in order: one box after another, joined by arrows. Some boxes have a gap, and you fill it with words from the text.
1. Read the word limit, for example NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS.
2. Read the whole chart first. A process is told step by step, so the boxes before and after a gap show you where to look in the text.
3. Find that step in the text and copy the missing words exactly.
4. Check: the words fit the grammar of the box, and they name this step, not the one before or after.
body.uz:
Flow chart (blok-sxema) jarayon bosqichlarini tartib bilan koʻrsatadi: qutilar birin-ketin keladi va strelkalar bilan bogʻlanadi. Baʼzi qutilarda boʻsh joy bor, siz uni matndagi soʻzlar bilan toʻldirasiz.
1. Soʻz chegarasini oʻqing, masalan NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS (ikki soʻzdan oshmasin).
2. Avval butun sxemani oʻqing. Jarayon bosqichma-bosqich aytiladi, shuning uchun boʻsh joydan oldingi va keyingi qutilar matnning qayeriga qarashni koʻrsatadi.
3. Matndan shu bosqichni toping va yetishmayotgan soʻzlarni aynan koʻchiring.
4. Tekshiring: soʻzlar qutidagi gapga grammatik jihatdan mos kelsin va oldingi yoki keyingi bosqichni emas, aynan shu bosqichni bildirsin.
body.ru:
Flow chart (блок-схема) показывает шаги процесса по порядку: блок за блоком, соединённые стрелками. В некоторых блоках есть пропуск, и вы заполняете его словами из текста.
1. Посмотрите, какой лимит слов, например NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS (не больше двух слов).
2. Сначала прочитайте всю схему. Процесс описан шаг за шагом, поэтому блоки до и после пропуска подсказывают, где искать в тексте.
3. Найдите этот шаг в тексте и перепишите недостающие слова точно.
4. Проверьте: слова грамматически подходят к блоку и называют именно этот шаг, а не предыдущий или следующий.

body.en:
Text: "At Ridley School, pupils in the art club make paper from waste. First they tear old newspapers into strips and soak them in water overnight. Next they beat the wet paper into a pulp. They spread the pulp thinly on a wire screen and press out the water with a sponge. Finally the sheets dry on a washing line in the classroom."
Chart: tear newspapers into strips → soak overnight → beat into a ______ → spread on a ______ → dry on a washing line. (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS)
Gap 1. 1) Limit: two words. 2) After "a" comes a thing. 3) The step after soaking: "beat the wet paper into a pulp". 4) Answer: pulp.
Now you. Gap 2. 1) Limit: two words. 2) After "a" comes a thing. 3) Find the step after the pulp in the text. 4) Answer: ?
body.uz:
Matn: «At Ridley School, pupils in the art club make paper from waste. First they tear old newspapers into strips and soak them in water overnight. Next they beat the wet paper into a pulp. They spread the pulp thinly on a wire screen and press out the water with a sponge. Finally the sheets dry on a washing line in the classroom.»
Sxema: tear newspapers into strips → soak overnight → beat into a ______ → spread on a ______ → dry on a washing line. (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS — ikki soʻzdan oshmasin)
1-boʻsh joy. 1) Chegara: ikki soʻz. 2) «a» dan keyin narsa keladi. 3) Ivitishdan keyingi bosqich: «beat the wet paper into a pulp». 4) Javob: pulp.
Endi siz. 2-boʻsh joy. 1) Chegara: ikki soʻz. 2) «a» dan keyin narsa keladi. 3) Matndan pulp dan keyingi bosqichni toping. 4) Javob: ?
body.ru:
Текст: «At Ridley School, pupils in the art club make paper from waste. First they tear old newspapers into strips and soak them in water overnight. Next they beat the wet paper into a pulp. They spread the pulp thinly on a wire screen and press out the water with a sponge. Finally the sheets dry on a washing line in the classroom.»
Схема: tear newspapers into strips → soak overnight → beat into a ______ → spread on a ______ → dry on a washing line. (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS — не больше двух слов)
Пропуск 1. 1) Лимит: два слова. 2) После «a» идёт предмет. 3) Шаг после замачивания: «beat the wet paper into a pulp». 4) Ответ: pulp.
Теперь попробуйте сами. Пропуск 2. 1) Лимит: два слова. 2) После «a» идёт предмет. 3) Найдите в тексте шаг после pulp. 4) Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out: the text does not always tell the steps in the order they happen.
"Before the logs are cut, they are dried for a year" means: first dry, then cut.
Words to watch: before, after, once, until, first, finally.
So build the order from these words, not from the order of the sentences.
Also check the boxes on both sides of the gap: a word from the step before or after is wrong, even if it is in the right sentence of the text.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: matn bosqichlarni har doim ham sodir boʻlish tartibida aytmaydi.
«Before the logs are cut, they are dried for a year» degani: avval quritiladi, keyin kesiladi.
Eʼtibor beradigan soʻzlar: before, after, once, until, first, finally.
Demak, tartibni gaplarning ketma-ketligidan emas, shu soʻzlardan tuzing.
Boʻsh joyning ikki tomonidagi qutilarni ham tekshiring: oldingi yoki keyingi bosqichga oid soʻz, hatto matnning toʻgʻri gapida boʻlsa ham, notoʻgʻri.
body.ru:
Осторожно: текст не всегда называет шаги в том порядке, в каком они происходят.
«Before the logs are cut, they are dried for a year» значит: сначала сушат, потом пилят.
Следите за словами: before, after, once, until, first, finally.
Стройте порядок по этим словам, а не по порядку предложений.
Проверьте и блоки по обе стороны пропуска: слово из предыдущего или следующего шага неверно, даже если оно стоит в нужном предложении текста.

stem.en:
A  The Brindle Street swimming pool opened in 1964 and was the town's only indoor pool for forty years.

B  Last year the pool closed for six months, because the roof had started to leak and the old heating system used too much gas.

C  The new roof has glass panels, so the pool is light even in winter. A small café now looks over the water.

D  Swimming lessons for children start again in March. Places are free for pupils from the town's schools.

Which paragraph gives a reason why the pool closed for a time?

why.en: Paragraph B: the pool closed "because the roof had started to leak" and the heating "used too much gas". C talks about the new roof only.
why.uz: B xatboshi: hovuz yopilgan, «because the roof had started to leak», isitish esa «used too much gas». C da faqat yangi tom bor.
why.ru: Абзац B: бассейн закрыли, «because the roof had started to leak», а отопление «used too much gas». В C только новая крыша.

instructions.en: Read the text. Which paragraph contains this information? Choose one.
instructions.uz: Matnni oʻqing. Bu maʼlumot qaysi xatboshida bor? Bittasini tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте текст. В каком абзаце есть эта информация? Выберите один.

stem.en:
A  Hollin Farm grows apples and pears on a hill above the village of Cray.

B  In 2019 a late frost killed most of the blossom, and the farm lost half its apples.

C  Since then the farm has planted hedges, which shelter the trees from cold wind.

D  On Saturdays in September, visitors can pick their own fruit and buy juice at the gate.

Which paragraph mentions an event that made a harvest smaller?

why.en: Paragraph B: "a late frost killed most of the blossom, and the farm lost half its apples". Losing half the apples is a smaller harvest.
why.uz: B xatboshi: «a late frost killed most of the blossom, and the farm lost half its apples». Olmaning yarmi yoʻqoldi — hosil kamaydi.
why.ru: Абзац B: «a late frost killed most of the blossom, and the farm lost half its apples». Половина яблок потеряна — урожай меньше.

stem.en:
A  The museum in Carrow Bay is known for its collection of old sea maps. Many visitors come only to see them.

B  Some of the maps are very fragile. The rooms are kept dark, and each map is shown for three months and then rested for a year.

C  The museum shop sells copies of the maps, printed on strong paper.

D  From 2027, a second room will show maps that have never been on display.

Which paragraph explains why some maps are not always on show?

why.en: Paragraph B: the maps are "very fragile", so each is shown for three months and then rested. D repeats "show" and "display" but gives no reason.
why.uz: B xatboshi: xaritalar «very fragile», shuning uchun har biri uch oy koʻrsatilib, keyin bir muddat olib qoʻyiladi. D da «show», «display» bor, sabab yoʻq.
why.ru: Абзац B: карты «very fragile», поэтому каждую показывают три месяца, потом она «отдыхает». В D есть «show» и «display», но нет причины.

stem.en:
At the Fenmoor apple press, apples are first washed in cold water to remove soil and leaves. They are then cut into small pieces by a machine and pressed between heavy cloths until the juice runs out. The juice is heated for a short time to kill any germs, and it is poured into glass bottles while it is still hot. The bottles are cooled slowly and stored in a dark room.

Complete the flow chart. Use NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the text.

Apples are washed in cold water.
↓
Apples are cut into small pieces.
↓
The pieces are pressed between ______.
↓
The juice is heated, then poured into bottles.

why.en: "heavy cloths": the pieces are "pressed between heavy cloths". Bottles and cold water belong to other steps; "heavy metal plates" is not in the text.
why.uz: «heavy cloths»: boʻlaklar «pressed between heavy cloths». Shishalar va sovuq suv boshqa bosqichlarda; «heavy metal plates» matnda yoʻq.
why.ru: «heavy cloths»: куски «pressed between heavy cloths». Бутылки и холодная вода — другие шаги; «heavy metal plates» в тексте нет.

instructions.en: Complete the flow chart with words from the text. Keep to the word limit.
instructions.uz: Blok-sxemani matndagi soʻzlar bilan toʻldiring. Belgilangan soʻz sonidan oshmang.
instructions.ru: Заполните блок-схему словами из текста. Не превышайте лимит слов.

stem.en:
At Ridley School, pupils in the art club make paper from waste. First they tear old newspapers into strips and soak them in water overnight. Next they beat the wet paper into a pulp. They spread the pulp thinly on a wire screen and press out the water with a sponge. Finally the sheets dry on a washing line in the classroom.

Complete the flow chart. Use NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the text.

The wet paper is beaten into a pulp.
↓
The pulp is spread thinly on a ______.
↓
The sheets dry on a washing line.

why.en: "wire screen": the pupils "spread the pulp thinly on a wire screen". The sponge presses out the water; the washing line is the last step.
why.uz: «wire screen»: oʻquvchilar «spread the pulp thinly on a wire screen». Gubka suvni siqib chiqaradi; arqon — oxirgi bosqich.
why.ru: «wire screen»: ученики «spread the pulp thinly on a wire screen». Губкой отжимают воду, а сушка на верёвке — последний шаг.

stem.en:
At the Dunmore pottery, each bowl is fired twice in the kiln. Before the first firing, the new bowls are dried on wooden racks for a week. Once that firing is over, they are dipped in glaze. Then they go back into the kiln for a second firing, at a higher heat. Finally, every bowl is checked for cracks before it goes on sale.

Complete the flow chart. Use NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the text.

The new bowls are ______.
↓
First firing in the kiln
↓
The bowls are dipped in glaze.
↓
Second firing, at a higher heat
↓
Every bowl is checked for cracks.

why.en: "dried": "Before the first firing", the bowls "are dried", so drying comes first, though the text says it second.
why.uz: «dried»: «Before the first firing» kosalar «are dried», demak quritish birinchi, garchi matnda ikkinchi aytilgan boʻlsa ham.
why.ru: «dried»: «Before the first firing» миски «are dried», значит, сушка — первый шаг, хотя в тексте она названа второй.
